name: cyberincident-n3-prototipo
description: Plataforma CyberIncident con API REST, Express y base de datos SQLite

scripts.migrate: sequelize-cli db:migrate --config config/database.js --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders --models-path models
scripts.migrate:undo: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config config/database.js --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders --models-path models
scripts.seed: sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config config/database.js --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders --models-path models
